name: Punto Fijo

routes.outcome: Official municipal SUMITCA/Carirubana portal loaded. It identifies municipal tax administration and links cadastral certificate, registration, and urban-property procedures; no public map viewer was exposed.
Landing-page JavaScript was inspected. It references a local tcmmv.json fetch but exposed no parcel feature, map, or public cadastral API route.
Linked contributor portal was identified from the official landing page but was not entered or authenticated; owner, address, tax/account, and personal fields were not requested.
Guessed public portal route was not found; this does not establish absence of another route or citywide parcel absence.

Official procedure document states that cadastral certificate/empadronamiento requests are submitted through SIGAT and may require property document, RIF/identity, and sometimes UTM REGVEN topographic plan. No parcel geometry was returned.

Official municipal ordinance identifies the Unidad responsable del Catastro in Municipio Carirubana and regulates cadastral certificates and related services; it is custodian evidence, not a parcel data endpoint.
